nodes.title: Resource-constrained scheduling
nodes.summary: Sequence jobs on limited resources with processing times, release dates, and precedence.

nodes.title: Workforce rostering
nodes.summary: Assign people to shifts while covering demand and respecting rest or skill rules.

nodes.title: Capacitated vehicle routing
nodes.summary: Construct depot-based routes that visit customers and respect vehicle capacity.

nodes.title: Canonical disjunctive scheduling model
nodes.summary: Use start times and pairwise ordering binaries to prevent overlap and enforce precedence.

constraints: either i before j or j before i

nodes.title: Canonical capacitated routing model
nodes.summary: Use arc binaries, visit degree constraints, flow/load propagation, and subtour elimination.

nodes.title: Tasks overlap on one resource
nodes.summary: A schedule lacks a disjunctive non-overlap relation for jobs using the same machine or worker.

nodes.title: Route contains a subtour
nodes.summary: Degree constraints create disconnected cycles that do not return to the depot.

nodes.title: Route load is not propagated
nodes.summary: Vehicle capacity is checked globally or omitted rather than propagated along selected arcs.

nodes.title: Add resource disjunction
nodes.summary: For every conflicting pair, enforce one ordering with a tight time-window bound.

nodes.title: Eliminate disconnected subtours
nodes.summary: Use MTZ, single-commodity flow, lazy cuts, or another stated subtour method.

nodes.title: Propagate route load
nodes.summary: Use cumulative load variables or a valid flow formulation with vehicle capacity bounds.

nodes.title: Precedence and overlap check
nodes.summary: Recompute every predecessor relation and resource timeline for overlap.

nodes.title: Route connectivity check
nodes.summary: Verify each customer is visited once and every selected route connects to the depot without subtours.
